text: Looks like my Yamper really likes you, huh?\c\nAnyway, we’ve run into each other at a\ngood time.[VAR 0114(000B)]

You know the mural here in Stow-on-Side?
It’s said to tell the story of the hero of Galar
as well.\c
Though what’s there today is actually a replica
of the ancient art that used to be here...[VAR 0114(000B)]
You tend to have surprisingly sharp insight, so I\nwas wondering what you might think when you\r\nsee the ruins.[VAR 0114(000B)]
Wha...? What in the world was that? Sounds like\nit came from the direction of the ruins, too...[VAR 0114(000B)]
Let’s have a look! Come along, Yamper![VAR 0114(000B)]
